dedupe_keys.name: arme cabo verde electronic communications statistical indicator reports quarterly

description: ARME, the multisector economic regulator of Cabo Verde, publishes statistical indicator reports for electronic communications. A news item of 2026 announces the report for the first quarter of 2026, and the category page Relatório estatísticos e outros collects the reports. ARME also publishes results of mobile quality of service and coverage measurements, for example on the islands of Boa Vista and Sal. The reports give fixed and mobile subscribers, internet and broadband subscriptions, traffic and operator shares for CV Telecom and Unitel T+. Coverage: Cabo Verde, national totals by quarter, with some island detail in the measurement reports. Format and access: PDF reports on the ARME website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the category page gave no document links to a plain request, so the number of reports and the period covered are not confirmed; PDF only. Simulation uses: demand and service quality baselines for an island archipelago network, for capacity planning and resilience studies. Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives national series; data-ookla-open-data-performance-tiles gives measured speeds by island.
licence: not stated (only a site copyright notice on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
